summary: Creates tests/test_research_capture_driver.py, a host harness that extracts the real idma_research_capture() from linux/drivers/misc/idma_research.h, the real IDMA_/RESEARCH_ object-like macros from idma.c + idma_research.h (plus an idma*.h fallback if IDMA_OBS_MAGIC_V8 is not in idma.c), and compiles the verbatim UAPI header (linux/include/uapi/linux/idma.h) into a temporary include dir reached with -I. Stubs replace only the hardware observation primitives: idma_research_read (fake 4096-word bank), idma_research_write (records the last write), kcalloc (with a forced-failure switch), kfree, copy_to_user (with a forced-failure switch plus a user-buffer sentinel) and u64_to_user_ptr. The extracted function is pasted unchanged; validation logic is never reimplemented. The C harness drives the contract: stage==0 -> error/-EIO with no read/write/copy; kcalloc failure -> -ENOMEM; valid E2 (raw[6]==4, no COST header needed) -> 0 with raw_captured==4096; valid COST with the new 0xD00 aggregation bank -> 0; COST with 0xD00==0 -> 0 (old-BIT compatibility); each of magic/version/group-count/stride/error/total/transfer/window corruptions -> -EIO while the full 4096-word raw bank is still copied (raw retained); copy_to_user failure -> -EFAULT with raw_captured unset; a caller error triggers exactly one abort write. Only the new file is added; no driver or other file is touched. This is a host compile/exercise only and makes no board claim.
checks: Run: python3 -m unittest tests.test_research_capture_driver -v (or python3 tests/test_research_capture_driver.py). Expected: the harness compiles with the host cc and prints 'OK: idma_research_capture honoured the raw-bank contract'; on hosts without cc / host <linux/types.h>+<linux/ioctl.h> / missing driver sources the test skips with a clear message.

Extraction sanity (asserted in Python before compiling): the pasted text contains 'return -ENOMEM', 'raw[0xc00]', 'raw[0xd00] &&', 'raw_captured = IDMA_RESEARCH_RAW_WORDS', 'RESEARCH_ABORT' and 'copy_to_user', and no mutation/replacement is applied to the extracted function.

Constants come from real sources: IDMA_OBS_MAGIC_V8, IDMA_RESEARCH_MAGIC, RESEARCH_COMMAND, RESEARCH_ABORT are all found by the extractor; the UAPI header is copied verbatim and reached through -I; IDMA_RESEARCH_RAW_WORDS is asserted to be 4096 at runtime.
stage == 0 with error 0 returns -EIO; with error -EINTR returns -EINTR; in both cases no idma_research_read, no idma_research_write and no copy_to_user occur and raw_captured stays 0.
kcalloc returning NULL yields -ENOMEM with zero hardware reads, zero copies and raw_captured == 0.

Valid E2 bank (raw[0]==IDMA_RESEARCH_MAGIC, raw[1]==IDMA_OBS_MAGIC_V8, raw[3]==0, raw[6]==4) returns 0, reads all 4096 words, sets raw_captured == 4096 and copies the exact raw bank. E2 with 0xC00/0xD00 words set to arbitrary values is still accepted (no COST header required); E2 with raw[6]!=4 or a wrong observer magic returns -EIO while still copying the full 4096-word bank.

Valid new COST bank (0xC00 magic, 0xC01==6, 0xC02==0, 0xC11/0xC12==transfers, 0xC19==p4m.window[1], 0xD00 magic, 0xD01==1, 0xD02==6, 0xD03==16, 0xD04==0, 0xD05==0xC14) returns 0, reads all 4096 words, performs no abort write, sets raw_captured == 4096 and copies the exact raw bank; COST ignores the E2 raw[6] phase rule.
Old-BIT compatibility: COST with raw[0xD00] == 0 (and arbitrary 0xD01..0xD05, including 0xD05 != 0xC14) returns 0 with the full raw bank retained.

Each of these COST corruptions returns -EIO while raw_captured is still set to 4096 and the copied bytes still equal the raw bank: bank magic (0xC00), version (0xC01), error word (0xC02), window[1] (0xC19), transfer counts (0xC11, 0xC12), observer magic (raw[0]), observer version (raw[1]), observer error word (raw[3]), aggregation magic (0xD00), aggregation version (0xD01), group count (0xD02), stride (0xD03), error word (0xD04), total (0xD05 != 0xC14).
copy_to_user failure returns -EFAULT, is attempted exactly once, leaves the user buffer at its sentinel value and leaves raw_captured == 0.

A caller error (e.g. -EIO or -EINTR) with a valid bank returns 0 from capture and issues exactly one idma_research_write(RESEARCH_COMMAND, RESEARCH_ABORT); with a corrupt bank it returns -EIO and still issues exactly that one abort write; the full raw bank is retained in both cases.
Full-file scope check: no file other than tests/test_research_capture_driver.py is added or modified.
uncertainties: IDMA_OBS_MAGIC_V8 is referenced by linux/drivers/misc/idma_research.h but not defined in any supplied file. The test therefore extracts IDMA_/RESEARCH_ object-like macros from idma.c and idma_research.h and, if the observer magic is absent there, falls back to scanning all *.h in linux/drivers/misc. If the constant actually lives elsewhere (e.g. a non-*idma* file outside that directory) the fallback will not find it and the test will fail with a clear 'must be taken from the real driver sources' message rather than invent a value. Codex should confirm the real location of IDMA_OBS_MAGIC_V8 (and the IDMA_OBS_*_OFFSET constants) and widen the fallback list if needed.

The 0xC00/0xD00 raw index meanings are taken from docs/research-fullstats-v1.md (0xD01 version=1, 0xD02 groups=6, 0xD03 stride=16, 0xD04 sticky errors, 0xD05 total==0xC14) and from the literal checks in the extracted function; the corruption cases are written against those literals. If the RTL/header changes an index or expected value, the corresponding EXPECT_COST_EIO case must be updated to match the real function text.

The host must provide <linux/types.h> and <linux/ioctl.h> that can compile the checked-in UAPI header (the sibling tests/test_research_solo_driver.py makes the same assumption). The probe-based skip keeps this honest on hosts that cannot.

The multi-line #define filter (values ending in a backslash are skipped) is a safety measure for generated C; if a required macro is ever written as a continued line the test fails loudly instead of silently compiling a truncated macro.

This test only proves the software reader's contract. It cannot validate the driver drain path (idma_research_e2), memory ordering, or any RTL behaviour; those still require Codex review and real board evidence, which is not claimed here.
